summary.result: As the outer validation method showed more accurate evaluation results, we used outer validation indices-sensitivity, specificity and accuracy-for comparison analysis between ensemble and single model results.
summary.background: As inner validation has established flaws, with using the data in the form of ‘point’, the need to assess outer validation with independent data in a polygon formations has been raised.
summary.method: Single models tend to overestimate compared to ensemble models, with a high value of sensitivity and a low value of specificity, whereas ensemble models tended to decrease the spatial uncertainty of single models, with generally high values of sensitivity, specificity and accuracy.
